name: IRAS 15250+3609 (Webb)
blurb: IRAS 15250+3609, an ultraluminous infrared galaxy, seen by Webb.
label: ir15250-webb
story: Most of this galaxy's light is hidden by dust and given off again as infrared, a hallmark of galaxies caught in mergers. Here a dwarf galaxy is falling into the host's core in a minor merger.

claims.text: IRAS 15250+3609 is an ultraluminous infrared galaxy
Webb program 3368 (A JWST Survey of Ultraluminous Infrared Galaxies) observed IR15250, an interacting infrared galaxy
ULIRGs emit most of their light from dust and are linked to galaxy mergers
A dwarf galaxy is falling into the host's nuclear region in a minor merger
